links.outcome: Exact-match accuracy of LLM treatment decisions with vs without guideline retrieval (RAG) grounding
links.effect: Accuracy increased with structured inputs, few-shot exemplars, and RAG across all models; best configuration (few-shot+RAG, structured notes) gave GPT-oss-120B 86.5% treatment allocation exact match; zero-shot unstructured baseline substantially lower.
links.quote: For decision support, accuracy increased with structured inputs, few-shot exemplars, and RAG across all models.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid REGEX+LLM clinical concept extraction from notes
Structuring input notes and few-shot exemplars to improve LLM accuracy
Locally hosted open-weight LLMs for privacy

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance across ablation configurations specifically testing the effect of adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) using clinical guidelines versus without RAG on decision accuracy.
